apps_midi_control_support: APPS / MIDI CONTROL / SUPPORT
answers_for_midi_control_for: Answers for MIDI Control for Fireface, and a direct line to us when something does not work.
in_the_app_choose_help: In the app, Help ▸ Report a Problem… drafts a message to support in your own mail app, with a diagnostic log attached: the app and macOS versions, the Mac’s model, and each device’s name, model, link, ports and log. Never an account, a path or an address. Untick the log to leave it out. Nothing is sent until you send it.
help_logs_l_shows_the: Help ▸ Logs… ⌥⌘L shows the same log.
questions_about_purchase_the_trial: Questions about purchase, the trial or anything else? Use the contact form.
do_i_need_firewire_or: Do I need FireWire or TotalMix?
no_the_app_talks_to: No. The app talks to the Fireface 800’s stand-alone mixer over plain MIDI, through any USB-MIDI interface. It needs no FireWire and nothing flashed beforehand: it works with whatever the unit powers on with.
do_i_have_to_enable: Do I have to enable MIDI control in TotalMix?
no_the_units_stand_alone: No. The unit’s stand-alone mixer answers MIDI whatever that setting says. It only governs TotalMix’s own MIDI remote while the unit is connected over FireWire.
which_midi_interface_do_i: Which MIDI interface do I need?
any_usb_midi_interface_with: Any USB-MIDI interface with one input and one output. Connect its output to the Fireface’s MIDI In and its input to the Fireface’s MIDI Out, then open Connection… and pick both ports.
which_macs_and_macos_versions: Which Macs and macOS versions are supported?
macos_13_ventura_to_macos: macOS 13 Ventura to macOS 27 Golden Gate, on Apple silicon, and on Intel Macs up to macOS 26 Tahoe.
does_it_support_the_fireface: Does it support the Fireface 400 or other RME interfaces?
the_fireface_800_is_supported: The Fireface 800 is supported today. The Fireface 400 shares its MIDI scheme and is planned once it is validated on hardware. Other RME interfaces are not supported.
why_cant_i_find_eq: Why can’t I find EQ, dynamics, metering or preamp gain?
the_fireface_800s_stand_alone: The Fireface 800’s stand-alone mixer does not offer them over MIDI: they live in TotalMix. The app covers what the unit itself exposes: sends, pans, mutes, output faders, +48 V and the setup. It adds its own Monitor Dim and Mute on the pairs you choose.
why_does_the_app_not: Why does the app not follow the front-panel knobs?
the_front_panel_sends_nothing: The front panel sends nothing over MIDI, so the app cannot see a knob being turned.
why_does_the_app_ask: Why does the app ask what +48 V powers on with?
the_unit_never_reports_phantom: The unit never reports phantom power, so the app keeps track of it itself. Tell it once, in Set Up…, what the unit powers on with, and every switch after that is counted from there. A recall that would flip +48 V names the mics first.
what_happens_when_i_switch: What happens when I switch the unit off and on?
the_unit_reloads_its_stored: The unit reloads its stored settings and forgets everything set over MIDI. The app notices, reads the unit back, and offers to restore the mix you had.
can_i_use_more_than: Can I use more than one Fireface 800?
yes_each_unit_is_a: Yes. Each unit is a device of its own, with its own ports and snapshots.
download_the_app_from_the: Download the app from the Mac App Store and start the 14-day trial inside it. Every feature is included, with no account and no card.
the_app_is_a_one: The app is a one-time purchase, with no subscription. A live link to your unit is never cut when the trial ends.
i_bought_it_on_another: I bought it on another Mac. How do I get it back?
choose_restore_purchases_in_the: Choose Restore Purchases in the app menu.
use_the_contact_form_or: Use the contact form or Help ▸ Report a Problem… in the app.
